method: Replay the Stage 0/1 browser workflow probes on Stage 2 using frame settling, visible dock controls and exposed drag handles; results match both tagged-base and accepted Stage 1 evidence exactly. Direct color-editor pointer/keyboard workflows are also compared on the tagged base and proposed change in the same browser. Production behavior and original suite assertions are unchanged.

supplementaryChecks.workflow: Frame-settled two-cube fit composition restores camera pose/frustum, zoom and renderer dimensions
Unsafe layout poll reproduces the null error; null-safe poll observes the saved layout
Empty Edit starts with Build open/checked; its checked Panels row closes it
Compact bottom Properties scrolls when the wheel is inside its visible body
Reveal Properties, then run defaults, independent bonds/objects, modes, edit/undo, sessions, Looks and trajectory checks
Use the exposed Atom-placement handle for live orbital filters, exclusive windows, camera safety, reset cancellation, Build search and operator interactions

listedWorkflows: With two cube layers, change iso and wait for a presented frame; compose fit/current-camera PNG and SVG grids. Compare camera pose, frustum, renderer size and graph before/after.
Repeat with Edit suppression, forced capture failure and abort; verify visibility, inert UI, playback and camera restore.
Save two scenes, reload, leave recovery pending and open live Coordinates/Properties/Subspace panels; confirm the saved snapshot is untouched until an explicit choice.
Recover and dismiss in separate fresh pages; verify measurements, layout and named active structure. Wait for the saved-layout record safely.
Enter Edit with both an empty scene and a loaded structure; verify initial Build/Transform choice and Panels checkmarks.
Place an atom/fragment/molecule, change modes, then float/minimize/reopen Build; verify search, placement, saved-layout and legacy behavior.
Reveal Properties Object explicitly, toggle Hydrogen bonds independently of chemical bonds, edit coordinates and undo; check contacts and topology.
Switch molecule layers, round-trip new/old sessions and play a trajectory; check per-object flags, defaults, contact counts and Look independence.
In Edit select atoms, focus an axis endpoint, use arrows/Home/End/Space/Enter and Escape; verify selection and focus against the tagged base.
Check all six directions in both projections and modes, pointer/touch gestures, small viewports and canvas PNG/WebM rendering. Record the pre-existing Escape defect if still present.

Exercise Escape from menus, coordinate/operator fields, provisional placement, armed Build, selected Transform, Focus and panels; preserve cancellation/disarm/selection-clear precedence and gizmo focus return.
Repeat the legacy two-atom fixture after the preceding auto-hydrogen/import actions, select both atoms, wait for the cue to be visible and drag Translate; verify displacement and undo.
Repeat Rotate and bond-group selection/operator inputs, including shifted/rotated content and camera changes. Verify actual frame presentation instead of a fixed sleep.
Import legacy multiple/over-coordinated H bonds; verify repair to a single bond.
Explicitly choose Build and attempt bond-order cycling/growth from saturated H; then choose Transform and check scope selection, metal styles and topology export.
affectedFailingSuites.stage2Outcome: Initial material-control timeout at looks.py:107 did not reproduce in paired focused/full replays; full replay fails at the same stale assertion at looks.py:978. Timeout mechanism unresolved.

listedWorkflows: Use foreground covalent/strong/dative/weak bonds overlapping a selected rear atom in both projections; click exposed centers and dash gaps, then wait for presented UI.
Check hover/frontmost ownership, metal-style cues, rear-atom deselection and live coordinate changes under every Look.
Open Coordinates in the legacy interface, enter Edit and select two atoms; attempt row Delete/Copy/Reorder with the selection card visible.
Move panels to expose controls, perform edits and undo, then repeat in Workbench; verify atom IDs, selection remapping, units and clipboard round-trips. Record the default legacy overlap.
In the legacy Style Studio, apply every Look and compare camera pose within a documented 1e-12 tolerance, molecule topology and material/geometry values.
Edit materials/geometry, Undo/Revert, save/import named Looks and switch themes; verify popup layout and live rendering.
Select structures and surfaces together; edit Object/Look controls, 2C cloud settings and per-surface inheritance.
Float/park/reopen Properties, cycle Edit/Measure/View and verify Object/Look tab and placement separately from the intentional first-Measure panel introduction.
Place Properties right, bottom and floating at desktop/mobile widths; wheel inside the visible Look body and verify scroll movement.
Click each disclosure at fixed coordinates through pointer down/up, then Space/Enter; check first-click behavior, stable heading positions and no focus-induced scrolling.
Exercise actual exposed title bars/grips with overlapping windows, including Selection tools and Atom placement; verify drag, keyboard movement/reset and collapse clicks.
Repeat Build search, orbital filters, modal/reset menus and video controls, including touch/resize, reopen-position persistence and viewport bounds.
Select structures and surfaces together; edit Object/Look controls, 2C cloud settings and per-surface inheritance.
Float/park/reopen Properties, cycle Edit/Measure/View and verify Object/Look tab and placement separately from the intentional first-Measure panel introduction.
